title: 156. Design HashSet

examples.explanation: add(1), add(2); contains(1) is true, contains(3) is false; after remove(2), contains(2) is false.
Initially contains(5) is false. After add(5) it is true; after remove(5) it is false again.
No contains calls, so every entry is null.

hints: Store the keys in a hash set: add inserts, remove deletes, contains checks membership.
A boolean array of size 1000001 also works since keys are bounded, giving O(1) operations.
Construction, add and remove report "null"; each contains reports "true" or "false".
